arxiv-2109-15024.title: Non-parametric calibration of multiple related radiocarbon determinations and their calendar age summarisation
arxiv-2109-15024.creator: T. J. Heaton
arxiv-2109-15024.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by T. J. Heaton. Due to fluctuations in past radiocarbon ( 14 C) levels, calibration is required to convert 14 C determinations X i X_{i} into calendar ages θ i \theta_{i} . In many studies, we wish to calibrate a set of related samples taken from the same site or context, which have calendar ages drawn from the same shared, but unknown, density f ⁡ ( θ ) f(\theta) .

arxiv-2110-09377.title: Comparison Principles for Second-Order Elliptic/Parabolic Equations with Discontinuities in the Gradient Compatible with Finsler Norms
arxiv-2110-09377.creator: Peter S. Morfe and Panagiotis E. Souganidis
arxiv-2110-09377.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Peter S. Morfe and Panagiotis E. Souganidis. This paper is about elliptic and parabolic partial differential operators with discontinuities in the gradient which are compatible with a Finsler norm in a sense to be made precise. Examples of this type of problems arise in a number of contexts, most notably the recent work of Chatterjee and the second author [ 7 ] on scaling limits of discrete surface growth models as well as L ∞ − L^{\infty}- variational problems.

arxiv-2112-08426.title: Contact simulation of a 2D Bipedal Robot kicking a ball
arxiv-2112-08426.creator: Alphonsus Adu-Bredu
arxiv-2112-08426.description: Abstract This report describes an approach for simulating multi-body contacts of actively-controlled systems. In this work, we focus on the controls and contact simulation of a 2-dimensional bipedal robot kicking a circular ball. The Julia code and more video results of the contact simulation can be found at this URL: https://github.com/adubredu/contact_sim.

arxiv-2202-06859.title: Lagrangian mean curvature flow in the complex projective plane
arxiv-2202-06859.creator: Christopher G. Evans
arxiv-2202-06859.description: Abstract . We prove a Thomas–Yau-type conjecture for monotone Lagrangian tori satisfying a symmetry condition in the complex projective plane ℂ ​ ℙ 2 \mathbb{CP}^{2} . We show that such tori exist for all time under Lagrangian mean curvature flow with surgery, undergoing at most a finite number of surgeries before flowing to a minimal Clifford torus in infinite time.

arxiv-2307-06983.title: IR Design for Application-Specific Natural Language: 、 A Case Study on Traffic Data
arxiv-2307-06983.creator: Wei Hu, Xuhong Wang, Ding Wang, Shengyue Yao, Zuqiu Mao, Li Li, Fellow, IEEE, Fei-Yue Wang, Fellow, IEEE, Yilun Lin, Member, IEEE
arxiv-2307-06983.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Wei Hu, Xuhong Wang, Ding Wang, Shengyue Yao, Zuqiu Mao, Li Li, Fellow, IEEE, Fei-Yue Wang, Fellow, IEEE, Yilun Lin, Member, IEEE. In the realm of software applications in the transportation industry, Domain-Specific Languages (DSLs) have enjoyed widespread adoption due to their ease of use and various other benefits. With the ceaseless progress in computer performance and the rapid development of large-scale models, the possibility of programming using natural language in specified applications - referred to as Application-Specific Natural Language (ASNL) - has emerged.

arxiv-2310-16968.title: Understanding Social Structures from Contemporary Literary Fiction using Character Interaction Graph - Half Century Chronology of Influential Bengali Writers
arxiv-2310-16968.creator: Nafis Irtiza Tripto, Mohammed Eunus Ali
arxiv-2310-16968.description: Abstract Social structures and real-world incidents often influence contemporary literary fiction. Existing research in literary fiction analysis explains these real-world phenomena through the manual critical analysis of stories. Conventional Natural Language Processing (NLP) methodologies, including sentiment analysis, narrative summarization, and topic modeling, have demonstrated substantial efficacy in analyzing and identifying similarities within fictional works.

arxiv-2504-06205.title: HER-Seg: Holistically Efficient Segmentation for High-Resolution Medical Images
arxiv-2504-06205.creator: Qing Xu, Zhenye Lou, Chenxin Li, Yue Li, Xiangjian He, Fiseha Berhanu Tesema, Rong Qu, Wenting Duan, Zhen Chen
arxiv-2504-06205.description: Abstract High-resolution segmentation is critical for precise disease diagnosis by extracting fine-grained morphological details. Existing hierarchical encoder-decoder frameworks have demonstrated remarkable adaptability across diverse medical segmentation tasks. While beneficial, they usually require the huge computation and memory cost when handling large-size segmentation, which limits their applications in foundation model building and real-world clinical scenarios.

arxiv-2512-20514.title: Explainable time-series forecasting with sampling-free SHAP for Transformers
arxiv-2512-20514.creator: Matthias Hertel, Sebastian Pütz, Ralf Mikut, Veit Hagenmeyer, Benjamin Schäfer
arxiv-2512-20514.description: Abstract Time-series forecasts are essential for planning and decision-making in many domains. Explainability is key to building user trust and meeting transparency requirements. Shapley Additive Explanations (SHAP) is a popular explainable AI framework, but it lacks efficient implementations for time series and often assumes feature independence when sampling counterfactuals.

pmc-10535797.title: The Influence of pH Value on the Microstructure and Properties of Strontium Phosphate Chemical Conversion Coatings on Titanium
pmc-10535797.creator: Guochao Gu, Yibo Li, Kangqing Zuo, Guiyong Xiao
pmc-10535797.description: Strontium (Sr) is a trace element in the human body that can promote bone formation and inhibit bone absorption. A conversion coating of strontium phosphate (Sr-P) on the surface of titanium (Ti) can improve its biological properties and has many potential applications in the fields of dentistry and orthopedics.

pmc-11391402.title: High-Resolution Drift Tube Ion Mobility Spectrometer with Ultra-Fast Polarity Switching
pmc-11391402.creator: Moritz Hitzemann, Ansgar T. Kirk, Martin Lippmann, Alexander Nitschke, Olaf Burckhardt, Jonas Winkelholz, Stefan Zimmermann
pmc-11391402.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Besides safety and security applications, ion mobility spectrometry (IMS) is increasingly used in other fields such as medicine, environmental monitoring and food quality analysis. However, some applications require gas chromatographic separation before analysis by IMS. Furthermore, different compounds in the sample may form positive or negative ions during ionization and therefore simultaneous detection of both ion polarities is highly beneficial to avoid two chromatographic runs of the same sample.

pmc-12426738.title: Nodal surgery in early-stage cervical cancer: the PHENIX trial and the road ahead
pmc-12426738.creator: Connor C Wang, Emma L Barber
pmc-12426738.description: –20% will have nodal metastases, potentially leading to overtreatment of a majority of patients with early-stage cervical cancer [4,5]. To that end, sentinel lymph node biopsy (SLNB) has emerged as a promising de-escalation strategy. It offers accurate nodal staging with lower morbidity, and it enables ultrastaging to detect micrometastases and isolated tumor cells (ITCs) that standard pathology may miss [2,3].

pmc-12471639.title: A Validated CFD Model for Gas Exchange in Hollow Fiber Membrane Oxygenators: Incorporating the Bohr and Haldane Effects
pmc-12471639.creator: Seyyed Hossein Monsefi Estakhrposhti, Jingjing Xu, Margit Gföhler, Michael Harasek
pmc-12471639.description: Chronic respiratory diseases claim nearly four million lives annually, making them the third leading cause of death worldwide. Extracorporeal membrane oxygenation (ECMO) is often the last line of support for patients with severe lung failure. Still, its performance is limited by an incomplete understanding of gas exchange in hollow fiber membrane (HFM) oxygenators.

pmc-12501958.title: Unraveling Evolution in the Homoploid Complex of Baccharis L. in Chile
pmc-12501958.creator: Fabian Schneider, Olga Zafra‐Delgado, Tobias G. Köllner, Frank Hellwig
pmc-12501958.description: Baccharis × intermedia (Asteraceae), found in central Chile, is a naturally occurring hybrid derived from the parent species B. macraei and B. linearis. It represents an extraordinary example of admixture with additive plant chemistry; however, the genetic structure of the hybrid complex and its evolution are still unclear.

pmc-12653664.title: Secondary Prevention Strategies for Ischemic Stroke in Antiphospholipid Syndrome
pmc-12653664.creator: Jonathan Naftali, Sheree Finkelshtain, Eitan Auriel, Chrong-Reen Wang, Emmanuel Favaloro
pmc-12653664.description: Introduction: Antiphospholipid syndrome (APS) is an autoimmune prothrombotic disorder associated with both venous and arterial thrombosis, most notably ischemic stroke. Patients face a high risk of recurrence, and yet optimal strategies for secondary prevention remain uncertain. Methods: We conducted a narrative review of the literature on secondary prevention of ischemic stroke in APS.

pmc-12679516.title: Comparison of in‐Hospital Complication Rates After Transcatheter Aortic Valve Replacement in Patients With Bicuspid Versus Tricuspid Aortic Valves: A Retrospective Cohort Study
pmc-12679516.creator: Tingxi Zhu, Jiawei Luo, Xuan Huang, Lulu Liu, Kehan Li, Wei He, Xiaobo Zhou, Yingqiang Guo, Xiaoyan Yang
pmc-12679516.description: BackgroundTranscatheter aortic valve replacement (TAVR) has become a popular alternative to surgical aortic valve replacement (SAVR) for patients with valvular heart disease (VHD), particularly for those with aortic anomalies.AimsThe study aimed to compare the risks of post‐TAVR complications between patients with bicuspid and tricuspid aortic valves and to identify associated risk factors.

pmc-12731586.title: Complications of Haploidentical Hematopoietic Cell Transplantation with Post-Transplant Cyclophosphamide—A Prospective Study on Behalf of the EBMT Transplant Complications Working Party
pmc-12731586.creator: Agnieszka Tomaszewska, Grzegorz W. Basak, Christophe Peczynski, Emmanuelle Polge, Pascale Ambron, William Boreland, Simona Sica, Mutlu Arat, Jakob Passweg, Jose Luis Lopez Lorenzo, Urpu Salmenniemi, Pavel Jindra, Alexander Kulagin, Rodrigo Martino Bufarull, Matthias Eder, Mohamed-Amine Bekadja, Albe
pmc-12731586.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Simple SummaryClinical applications of unmanipulated haploidentical hematopoietic cell transplantation with GvHD (graft versus host disease) prophylaxis using post-transplant cyclophosphamide (haplo-HCT with PTCy) have become widespread in therapy of various types of hematological malignancies. The aim of this prospective non-interventional multicenter study was to document frequency of potential non-infectious and infection-related complications and main transplant outcomes after the first haplo-HCT with PT-Cy between 2017 and 2019 in 129 adult patients. The median follow-up was 37.3 months [95% CI: 34.3–39.7].

pmc-13154980.title: NVX-CoV2372, monovalent mRNA and bivalent mRNA vaccines elicit broadly cross-reactive antibodies against emerging SARS-CoV-2 variants
pmc-13154980.creator: Xuan Ying Poh, Shirley Y. Y. Mah, Aileen Y. Y. Yeoh, Jean-Marc Chavatte, Daniel R. X. Lim, Cheryl C. Y. pmc-13154980.description: Randomized clinical trials comparing the breadth and long-term persistence of immunity between different COVID-19 vaccine types and between ancestral and Omicron-targeted vaccines are limited. The PRIBIVAC study (Phase D) is a randomized clinical trial comparing the immunogenicity of monovalent mRNA vs bivalent mRNA vs protein-based NVX-CoV2373 administered as second booster in 176 triple mRNA-vaccinated adults.

pmc-13223608.title: From feminine leisure to urban craze: the popularization of badminton in Republican Shanghai
pmc-13223608.creator: Zhuomiao Zhao, Chang Liu, Kohei Kawashima
pmc-13223608.description: This paper investigates the gendered popularization of badminton in semi-colonial and wartime Shanghai between 1912 and 1949, focusing on how the sport moved from expatriate enclaves into local society, how women entered and were represented within this process, and how its inherited gender meanings were reworked in China.
